popup.title: Citadel Streets
popup.description: A small and rather segregated district located on the north side of the [[Upper City]].

popup.title: Manorborn
popup.description: One of the four districts that composed the [[Upper City]], home to the richest members of the Baldurian [[patriar]], nearly every member of the [[Parliament of Peers]] resided in the district.

popup.title: Temples District
popup.description: The largest and perhaps the oldest and most important region in the entirety of the [[Upper City]].

popup.title: Seatower
popup.description: One of the largest districts of [[Baldur's Gate]], located on the northern shore of the [[River Chionthar]] and housed the western docks of [[Gray Harbor]].

popup.title: Bloomridge
popup.description: A wealthy district within the [[Lower City]], south of the [[Old Wall (Baldur's Gate)|Old Wall]], into which it was partially built via great feats of engineering, both structural and [[arcane]].

popup.title: The Steeps
popup.description: A district in the [[Lower City]] between the [[Old Wall (Baldur's Gate)|Old Wall]] and the eastern side of [[Gray Harbor]].

popup.title: Heapside
popup.description: A large district in the [[Lower City]], that gained its name following the [[Tax Revolts]] of the 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Eastway
popup.description: One of the larger districts of [[Baldur's Gate]].

popup.title: Brampton
popup.description: A district in south-eastern Baldur's Gate, noteworthy in that passage through it, was required to reach the [[Outer City]] district of [[Tumbledown]].

popup.title: Blackgate
popup.description: The region that served as a waiting area for merchants and caravaneers moving their goods along the [[Trade Way]]. They were forced to stable their pack animals in Blackgate, while their products were transferred to another conveyance while moving through the city.

popup.title: Stonyeyes
popup.description: The neighborhood that was home to a large community of [[half-orc]]s, many of whom worked as porters, helped in transporting goods to and from caravans coming to [[Baldur's Gate]], as their pack animals were not allowed within the city walls.

popup.title: Little Calimshan
popup.description: A rowdy and chaotic walled district in the [[Outer City]], distinct in its design and atmosphere that evoked its namesake realm of [[Calimshan]].

popup.title: Norchapel
popup.description: An [[Outer City]] neighborhood, home to many laborers and criminal gangs.

popup.title: Whitkeep
popup.description: A district in the [[Outer City]],  home to a sizable community of [[gnome]]s, many of whom worked as [[tin]]smiths within the city.

popup.title: Sow's Foot
popup.description: A district in the [[Outer City]] – the easternmost neighborhood located outside of the city walls, nestled in between [[Twin Songs]] and [[Whitkeep]].

popup.title: Twin Songs
popup.description: A district of the [[Outer City]] located on the northern side of the [[Wyrm's Crossing]] bridge that was an expansive collection of temples and shrines dedicated to nearly every deity including dark and malevolent deities.

popup.title: Tumbledown
popup.description: A lone and perpetually foggy district located within the [[Outer City]], the location of the [[Cliffside Cemetery]].

popup.title: Rivington
popup.description: The southernmost district of [[Baldur's Gate]] and the only region of the [[Outer City]] located on the southern shore of the [[River Chionthar]].

popup.title: Wyrm's Crossing
popup.description: This district was comprised of two massively-tall stone bridges that spanned the length of the [[River Chionthar]].
